scope: Source-mapped roof macrocycle plus B29 linker through the LysB29 NZ endpoint; this is not the complete insulin conjugate.

sources.cited_click_chemistry_reference: Meldal, M. & Tornøe, C. W. Cu-catalyzed azide-alkyne cycloaddition. Chemical Reviews 108, 2952–3015 (2008), cited as reference 17 in the article.

b29_linker.name: O-succinimidyl pentyn-1-oxycarbonyl
b29_linker.evidence: Extended Data Fig. 7a numbers linker carbons C3–C8; the article Methods and Supporting Information §4 describe coupling it to desB30 human insulin at B29 and displacement of the succinimidyl leaving group.
b29_linker.transferred_product_sequence: LysB29 NZ–C3(=O)–O–C4H2–C5H2–C6H2–C7≡C8H before click; C3–C8 labels are source labels.

roof_azide.evidence: Extended Data Fig. 8i numbers the roof propyl chain C21–C23 and shows terminal N3; the inherited graph maps C21–C23 to 78–80 and the azide nitrogens to 81–83.

click_product.reaction: Cu(I)-catalysed azide–alkyne cycloaddition, as described in the article Methods and Supporting Information.
click_product.evidence: Nature Fig. 2a directly draws the product with the roof propyl substituent bonded to triazole N1 and the B29 linker substituent bonded to C4. This assigns source azide N attached to C23 as N1, internal alkyne carbon C7 as C4, and terminal alkyne carbon C8 as C5. The atom assignment follows the primary product drawing, not PDB adjacency or distances.

bond_order_representation.smiles_bond_form: Explicit Kekulé single/double bonds are written for the new linker and click ring; RDKit sanitization perceives the triazole ring as aromatic.
bond_order_representation.consumed_terminal_alkyne: The precursor C7≡C8 triple bond is consumed; C7 map 88 and C8 map 89 are triazole ring atoms in the product.

representation_boundaries.roof_carboxyl_groups: All three macrocycle carboxyl groups retain the neutral COOH form drawn in the source: map groups [52,53,54], [60,61,62], and [68,69,70]. This is a graph representation choice, not a physiological protonation assignment.
representation_boundaries.lys_b29_cut: Map 92 is the NZ endpoint, represented as NH2 to cap the isolated graph and satisfy valence. The LysB29 CE continuation and all other insulin atoms are outside this graph. The computed total-hydrogen formula therefore describes this capped graph and is not the hydrogen formula of the actual conjugate.
representation_boundaries.stereochemistry: No stereochemistry is introduced beyond the source graph; the product drawing does not define additional stereocentres at the B29 linker or triazole.

validation.ring_count_note: RingInfo atom-ring count is reported separately from graph cycle rank; acceptance uses the independently computed E−V+components cycle rank.

limitations: The mapped PDB atom names are candidate labels from prior coordinate-mapping audits and are not source-authoritative chemical atom names.
The graph does not include the LysB29 CE continuation, the remaining insulin atoms, or the separate B1 glucoside.
The neutral-acid and NH2-cap hydrogen assignments do not establish physiological protonation, partial charges, force-field parameters, or simulation readiness.
